facts.fact: The Blueprint carries forewords by the President and the Prime Minister and calls itself 'Government's commitment' and a 'strategic roadmap'; the document states no approving or adopting act or body, so no adoption verb is quoted.

The full text is published on the MITCI site, is titled 2025-2029, and describes itself as a whole-of-nation transformation of the state and the economy (four pillars including Economy, five enablers).

The Blueprint lists actions per pillar and enabler and says it contains a phased roadmap with milestones and indicators; it states no cost or budget figure for the Blueprint.

The Blueprint says the National Digital Transformation Bureau 'will be responsible for the execution of ICT projects' and a National Digital Transformation Steering Committee will oversee implementation; the NDTB is to be established.
The Blueprint states no budget line or allocation for itself; it mentions only that 'provision will be made' for some partnership programmes.
